title: #106 Effective Study
prompt: Effective study requires time, comfort and peace. It is impossible to combine a student's learning with employment because one may distract the other. To what extent do you think the statements are realistic? Give your opinion with examples.

promptSegments.text: Effective study requires time, comfort and peace.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Students require dedicated time and a quiet environment to concentrate on their studies and perform well.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Combining work and study is difficult because job responsibilities can distract students, potentially lowering their grades.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Working part-time does not necessarily stop the learning process, as students can find time to study, for instance, in the evening after a shift.

modelPlan.focus: evaluate the reality of the statement that effective study requires time, comfort, and peace, and that combining study with employment is impossible due to distractions.
outline: body1: Discuss the importance of time, comfort, and peace for effective study.
body2: Explain why combining study and employment can be challenging but not impossible.
keyArguments: Effective study requires dedicated time, a comfortable environment, and minimal distractions.
While combining study and employment presents challenges, it is possible with proper time management and prioritization.

plans.label: Version 1: AGREE
plans.thesisFrame: In my view, Education should be considered from the perspective of agree.
plans.point1: Optimal study requires a peaceful and dedicated setting, as the concentration needed for deep learning cannot be maintained when constantly interrupted by work responsibilities, which increases cognitive load.
plans.point2: Furthermore, a job consumes substantial time and mental energy, forcing students to sacrifice rest periods and negatively impacting their academic performance, thus creating an unsustainable routine.

plans.label: Version 2: DISAGREE
plans.thesisFrame: In my view, Education should be considered from the perspective of disagree.
plans.point1: The first point argues that maintaining a dedicated study routine while working full-time is challenging because the demands of a paid job consume the time and mental energy needed for deep learning, leading to poor academic performance.
plans.point2: Furthermore, the second point suggests that balancing work and study compromises the optimal environment for learning because rigid employment schedules dictate life routines, leaving students constantly preoccupied and unable to dedicate sufficient attention to their education.
